title: review-ledger export, version 1
description: One line of `review-ledger export` output. Every line but the last is a record line; the last is the trailer. An export with no trailer was cut short and is not complete.

sourceKind.description: Where a record was read from. `pr-comment` is a legacy record posted on the pull request it describes; `store-issue` is reserved for the dedicated store.

repo.description: The repository the export read, as owner/name.

issue.description: The issue or pull request number the comment is on.

authorAssociation.description: The comment author's association with the repository. A record is exported only for these values.

updatedAt.description: Later than `createdAt` when the record was enriched in place; upsert on `record.idempotencyKey`.

record.description: The stored telemetry record as validated by the reader. Its own `version` governs its shape; this schema governs the envelope only.

sources.description: One entry per issue or pull request read.

commentsReported.description: The comment count GitHub reports; null when it could not be read.

commentsRead.description: The comments the export read; null when the listing could not be read.

records.description: Record lines written before this trailer.

duplicatesCollapsed.description: Later comments that replayed an exported record under the same idempotency key.

conflicts.description: Later comments that reused an exported record's idempotency key with different content. The earliest is exported.

rejectedAuthor.description: Comments carrying a telemetry marker whose author is not allowed to write records.

malformed.description: Comments from an allowed author whose telemetry marker carries no valid record.

complete.description: True only when, for every source, `commentsRead` equals `commentsReported`.
